acceptance: Pull the reviewer attempt logs for the affected heads and state the actual exit-1 cause (quota, sandbox, config, input size or other).
Fix the cause, or make the gate retry automatically with a bounded count so a rerun by hand is not needed.
Document in docs/agent what an agent may do when all attempts error, without needing an owner comment for a plain rerun.
Show the fix with a before/after on a PR head that previously failed, or a test of the retry path.
context: Evidence: PR #3887, #3888, #3891, #3896 on 2026-11-01..06. Also seen: the gate job failing after 35m-1h32m and a trunk.yml run queued over 69 minutes; check whether runner queueing is a separate cause. Verification rubric: reproduce or inspect logs first; fix; confirm a head that failed now gets a verdict; CI green.
description: During one batch, several PR heads (#3887 first head, #3888 first head, #3891, #3896) got no oracle verdict: every reviewer attempt ended 'absent (error): exit code 1', so oracle-gate stayed failing and make pr-arm refused. Recovery was by hand: gh run rerun of the verdict workflow, or amending the commit to force a new head. make oracle-backoff-reset needs an owner instruction comment, so workers could not use it. This added hours to landing. Root cause is unknown.
